CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Susan Jakubowski, Mayor  www.cityofsanmarino.org
Steve Talt, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone
Steven W. Huang, DDS, Council Member  (626) 300-0709 Fax
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber
Ken Ude, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Mario Rueda, Acting City Manager  San Marino, CA 91108

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 12, 2022 AT 6:00 P.M.
  BARTH ROOM CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY
  1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council with
valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically, adjourned
meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires
a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact
the City Clerk via email at cityclerk@cityofsanmarino.org or by phone at (626) 300-0705 prior
to the meeting for assistance.

  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (AB 361)
Members of the City Council may teleconference into the meeting without noticing each
teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID-19) ADVISORY
To protect both staff, our constituents, and elected officials, it is recommended that members of
the public wear a mask indoors, per the State and County Health Department’s current Health
Officer Orders. Given the seriousness of COVID-19, you are encouraged to provide input
electronically if you do not feel comfortable attending in person.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  1) Via Computer for Video Streaming:
  Website: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83316497270
  2) Via Phone for Audio Only:
  Phone Number: (669) 900-9128
  Meeting ID: 833 1649 7270
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – OCTOBER 12, 2022  PAGE 2 OF 5

How to offer public comment from home:

  1) Public comment will be accepted by email to cityclerk@cityofsanmarino.org until 3:00
  p.m. the day of the meeting, to be read by the City Clerk during public comment. Lengthy
  public comment may be summarized in the interest of time. Any comments received after
  3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but will not be read at the
  meeting.
  2) Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module
  during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL:  Council Member Huang, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Council
  Member Ude, Vice Mayor Talt, and Mayor Jakubowski

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall, 2200
Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman Building,
1560 Pasqualito Drive.  The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.CityofSanMarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At this
time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to
state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda
(Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place limits on duration
of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the City Manager to inform the City Council and the public of any
upcoming events or matters of interest to the community.

  NEW BUSINESS

1. ADOPTION OF MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING WITH THE POLICE
  OFFICERS’ ASSOCIATION AND RESOLUTION NO. R-22-40, APPROVING
  THE UPDATED 2022 SALARY SCHEDULE
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt the Memorandum of
  Understanding for the Police Officers’ Association, and Resolution No. R-22-24, Approving
  the Updated 2022 Salary Schedule.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – OCTOBER 12, 2022  PAGE 3 OF 5

2. APPROVAL OF FY 2021-22 BUDGET CARRYOVERS AND FY 2022-23 RE-
  BUDGETS
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the requested FY 2021-
  22 carryovers and the updates to the FY 2022-23 re-budgets.

3. AUTHORIZATION OF AN AGREEMENT WITH MATRIX AUDIO VISUAL
  DESIGNS FOR BARTH ROOM AV UPGRADES IN THE AMOUNT OF $78,657
  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council authorize the agreement with
  Matrix Audio Visual Designs for the Barth Room AV Upgrades in an amount of $78,657, and
  appropriate an additional $44,157 to account 591-90-4613-05555 (Barth Room AV
  Upgrades).

  CONSENT CALENDAR

4. RECEIVE AND FILE THE MONTHLY DISBURSEMENTS REPORT FOR
  SEPTEMBER 2022

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of September 2022.

5. RECEIVE AND FILE CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR AUGUST 2022

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the Cash and
  Investment Report for the month of August 2022.

6. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve the special meeting of
  September 2, 2022, the special meeting of September 14, 2022, the regular meeting of
  September 14, 2022, the special meeting of September 28, 2022, and the adjourned regular
  meeting of September 30, 2022.

7. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R-22-39 TO CONTINUE HYBRID PUBLIC
  MEETINGS PURSUANT TO AB 361

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R-22-39 re-
  authorizing the City Council and the City’s Boards and Commissions to continue
  teleconference accessibility for conducting public meetings pursuant to AB 361.

8. UPDATE ON CITY RESPONSE TO THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council receive and file the October 12,
  2022 report on the City’s response to the COVID-19 Pandemic.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – OCTOBER 12, 2022  PAGE 4 OF 5

9. COMMITMENT OF DONATIONS FUND YEAR-END BALANCE RESERVES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R-22-36 to
  commit the balance of $274,377 in the Donations Fund as of June 30, 2022.

10. AWARD OF PROFESSIONAL DESIGN SERVICES AGREEMENT TO NICHOLS
  CONSULTING ENGINEERS (NCE) FOR THE PREPARATION OF PLANS,
  SPECIFICATIONS, AND COST ESTIMATES FOR THE FY 2022-23 STREET
  REHABILITATION PROGRAM PROJECT NO. 22-9271 AND THE FY 2023-24
  STREET REHABILITATION PROGRAM PROJECT NO. 23-9271 IN AN
  AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $195,645 AND AUTHORIZATION FOR THE
  PARKS AND PUBLIC WORKS DIRECTOR TO APPROVE DESIGN CHANGE
  ORDERS IN AN AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $19,560

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council award a professional design
  services agreement to NCE of Fountain Valley, California, for the preparation of plans,
  specifications and cost estimate for the Fiscal Year 2022-23 Street Rehabilitation Program
  Project No. 22-9271 and Fiscal Year 2023-24 Street Rehabilitation Program Project No. 23-
  9271 in an amount not to exceed $195,645; authorize the City Manager to execute the
  agreement on behalf of the City; and authorize the Director of Parks and Public Works to
  approve design change orders in an amount not to exceed $19,560.

11. APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION NO. R-22-41 APPROVING THE FILING OF AN
  APPLICATION FOR RUBBERIZED PAVEMENT GRANT PROGRAM FUNDS
  FROM CALRECYCLE AND AUTHORIZATION TO APPROPRIATE $91,000
  INTO THE CALIFORNIA RECYCLING GRANT FUND

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve Resolution No. R-22-41
  approving the filing of an application for Rubberized Pavement Grant Program funds from the
  California Department of Resources Recycling and Recovery, and appropriate $91,000 into
  the California Recycling Grant Fund Account #226-48-3202-7155.

12. ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R-22-33, UPDATING THE CONFLICT OF
  INTEREST CODE OF THE CITY OF SAN MARINO

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution No. R-22-33
  updating the Conflict of Interest Code of the City of San Marino.

13. ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. O-22-1397 (SECOND READING)
  CORRECTING CHAPTER 23 ARTICLE 15 OF THE SAN MARINO MUNICIPAL
  CODE TO ADD BACK IN THE SECTION REGARDING MATTERS SUBJECT
  TO DESIGN REVIEW

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council waive full reading and adopt by
  title only, Ordinance No. O-22-1397 an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of San
  Marino, California Correcting Chapter 23 Article 15 of the San Marino Municipal Code to
  Add Back in the Section Regarding Matters Subject to Design Review.
 CITY COUNCIL AGENDA – OCTOBER 12, 2022  PAGE 5 OF 5

14. APPROVAL OF PURCHASE OF COMMAND POST TRAILER USING 2020
  STATE HOMELAND SECURITY PROGRAM GRANT FUNDS AND COPS
  FUNDS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council authorize the purchase of a
  command post trailer from Nappi Fabrication Designs using State of California 2020
  Homeland Security Program Funds in an amount not to exceed $67,518, and appropriate an
  additional $30,000 of COPS funds to account 233-30-4613-0000 (Capitalized Equipment).

15. APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION NO. R-22-31 ADOPTING THE 2022 CITY OF
  SAN MARINO EMERGENCY OPERATIONS PLAN

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve Resolution No. R-22-37
  adopting the 2022 City of San Marino Emergency Operations Plan.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City received
by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San Marino to at
least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made available at
the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108,
and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will available for review at the City
Council meeting.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

ADJOURNMENT

Dated: October 7, 2022  CHRISTINA BAKER
Posted: October 7, 2022  CITY CLERK
